from zipfile import ZipFile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
path='inputs/JuliaJong_CRISPRa_BCL2_B3GNT_cacerResTcellCytotoxicity_supplData1_mageck.xlsx'
ns={'m':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
with ZipFile(path) as z:
    root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    strings=[]
    for si in root.findall('m:si',ns):
        strings.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{%s}t'%ns['m'])))
    for sheet in ('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml','xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml','xl/worksheets/sheet3.xml'):

        dim=sr.find('m:dimension',ns).attrib.get('ref')
        row=sr.find(\"m:sheetData/m:row[@r='1']\",ns)
        vals=[]
        for c in row.findall('m:c',ns):
            v=c.find('m:v',ns)
            value='' if v is None else (strings[int(v.text)] if c.attrib.get('t')=='s' else v.text)
            vals.append((c.attrib.get('r'), value))
        print(sheet, dim, vals)
PY"
